parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy is offering 2 Wheat for 1 Sheep. Looking at my current resources, I have 1 Sheep, 1 Wheat, 1 Ore, and 1 Wood. My Brick 6 is currently blocked by the robber. Accepting this trade would give me 3 Wheat total. While Wheat is useful for settlements and cities, I am currently desperate for Brick to build my next settlement on the Ore port (Node 26) or towards Node 10. Jimmy has a lot of Wheat and Wood. Giving him my only Sheep might help him build a settlement if he gets Brick, but more importantly, I need to keep my Sheep for my own future settlement. However, 2-for-1 is a strong ratio. But wait, looking at the board, I have good sheep production (5 and 4), and Jimmy is offering Wheat which he has in abundance. Actually, I need to break the alliance between him and Gemma. Accepting might soften him up, but I'd rather trade for Brick. Since I can't get Brick from this trade and it depletes my Sheep, I will reject and try to negotiate for Brick or keep my resources for a 4:1 trade if necessary. Also, Jimmy just blocked me, so rewarding him with a trade he wants isn't ideal unless it significantly benefits me.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Jimmy's 2 Wheat for 1 Sheep. I need Brick more than Wheat right now since my 6 is blocked. Must focus on getting the robber off the 6.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, הצעה נדיבה, אבל חיטה זה הדבר האחרון שחסר לי כרגע כשהשודד יושב לי על הטיט. אם יש לך טיט להציע, נדבר. בינתיים אני אשאר עם הכבשה שלי.
